newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong building fire kills three.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong building fire kills three.

text.p: Three people were killed and six others injured by a fire that swept through a building in Hong Kong on Friday, the government said.
Sources at the scene said the police was treating the blaze as suspected arson and had made an arrest.
Nine people, including a fireman, were injured and taken to hospital where three of them were certified dead, the authorities said in a statement.

The fire broke out on the first floor of a building in Shau Kei Wan on Hong Kong island at 3:06 am local time (1906 GMT), and was extinguished about an hour and a half later, the government statement said.
Local radio described the building as a ramshackle four-storey structure.
